items.title: Billie Pierce and De De Pierce Interview, 1959-04-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] George Stewart. What did he play? [INTERVIEWEE] Clarinet? Sax. Sax. Most of the clarinet in that time, but he played a little sax too also. That George Stewart.

ctx.x: There's a, let me see, a guy which is called Bill Phillips, drummer. I don't know if he's working anymore, if he's still living. You see that drummer. I heard the door. I don't know if he's in sax. Oh, oh, oh, oh, oh, oh. Don't you remember when you work with Billy? The old man, he smoked him in cigarettes.
Oh, oh, oh, oh. George Stewart. Huh?
